findings.summary: Duplicates existing --no-messages, which the body never mentions
nopermission drops exit status 2, changing a documented design choice without an issue
Flag does not cover traversal/walker permission errors although the body says it does
Scratch files pullrequest.txt and purpose.txt committed; body reads machine-written
Unit tests race on global ERRORED and cannot catch a regression in silencing
Calls set_errored() directly against file comment; leaves field doc wrong
Field and impl ordering out of line with file layout
zsh completion in wrong exclusion group and offers no values
Value names read backwards; doc_long says only one supported value

why: Finding 1 states the flag duplicates --no-messages, the maintainer's reason.
